jobs.title: Clinical Research Associate II/ Senior Clinical Research Associate
jobs.description: Precision for Medicine is not your typical CRO. We are passionate about cultivating our culture and are proud to share extremely high CRA retention rates compared to industry averages. CRAs join us, love their jobs, and stay because of the amazing people and enjoyable quality of life. You will have a lower than average number of protocols, setting you up to be a protocol expert. Travel is reasonable and your work/life balance will benefit as a result. Most meaningfully - your voice will be heard. Working in a smaller CRO allows you to have influence and impact when it matters most and support from direct line management. We are hiring a Clinical Research Associate II/ Senior Clinical Research Associate, this position will be fully home based working in the UK or Northern Ireland.   About you: You are calm, thoughtful, and responsive when things don’t go as planned. You are well-prepared, whether it be for an investigator meeting, site visit or project team update, always staying two steps ahead of the game. You find quick and creative ways of overcoming difficulties. You have an impeccable eye for detail. You identify potential study risks and propose solutions on how to mitigate them. You take responsibility in the quality and outcomes of your work. You are adept at handling conflict by using tried and true resolution strategies. How we will keep you busy and support your growth: You will monitor and own the progress of clinical studies at investigative sites and ensure that clinical studies are conducted, recorded, and reported per protocol, SOPs, ICH-GCP, and all applicable regulations and standards. You will coordinate all necessary activities required to set up and monitor a study (i.e., identify investigators; helping prepare regulatory submissions, conducting pre-study and initiation visits, etc.). Qualifications: Minimum Required: 4-year college degree or equivalent experience Other Required: Candidates should ideally have more than 1 years CRA exp

jobs.title: Online Mental Health Social Worker
jobs.description: BetterHelp is one of the world’s largest online therapy platforms, connecting licensed therapists with clients looking for mental health support. With BetterHelp, you can grow your caseload without spending your time marketing a private practice or managing insurance administration. Set your schedule, work remotely, and focus your time on the clients you serve. Why Therapists Join BetterHelp Earn $43–$70/hour: Competitive hourly compensation for live sessions. First Client Bonus: Eligible therapists can earn a $500–$1,000 First Client Bonus , depending on their state of licensure, after seeing their first client within 30 days of applying.* Build your caseload: We match you with clients looking for care, including insurance and cash-pay clients. We handle the insurance work: BetterHelp supports credentialing, claims, and insurance administration. Get paid reliably: Guaranteed weekly payment for eligible sessions without worrying about claim denials or clawbacks. Work from anywhere: Provide therapy remotely from the comfort of your home. Set your own schedule: Choose the hours that work for you. Zero therapist fees: No marketing fees, membership fees, or practice overhead. More Benefits $650 monthly Health Benefit Stipend for eligible therapists who maintain a continuous commitment of 30 hours per week. Free access to 390+ CEU courses Free BetterHelp membership to support your own well-being Additional bonuses and incentives for eligible high performers Autonomy over your clinical decisions Access to a community of 30,000+ therapists Who We're Looking For We're looking for independently licensed mental health therapists, counselors, clinical social workers, marriage and family therapists, and psychologists who can provide therapy without supervision. Depending on your state of licensure, eligible licenses may include: Clinical Social Work LCSW, LICSW, LSCSW, LISW, LISW-S, LISW-CP, LCSW-C, LCSW-R, LCSW-BACS, MSLCSW Professional & Mental Health Counseling LPC, LMHC, LP

jobs.title: Health and Safety Engineer
jobs.description: We are looking for a Health & Safety Engineer to support safe operations across our facilities, construction activities, manufacturing, testing, and launch operations. This is a technical role focused on identifying hazards, developing effective controls, and helping teams work safely in a fast-moving engineering environment. You will work closely with operations, engineering, construction, manufacturing, test, and external contractors to ensure that safety is built into the way we work. Fluent German and experience working with German authorities would be a substantial advantage About us We’re a Germany-based rocketry startup currently in stealth mode, scaling up rapidly to meet the demand for high-performance, reliable, and scalable solid propulsion technologies for space and defense applications. We are already launching suborbital and ballistic rockets on a regular basis, have just crossed €10m in revenue for our first operating year and are applying our knowledge toward the development of an orbital rocket. We are working hard to build something truly spectacular. To thrive here you will need to be comfortable working at pace, with the autonomy to make decisions and execute on them quickly. If you’re excited by hard technical challenges and want a role where you will make a real difference each day to the future of the company, we may be the place for you. At our company, job titles and career progression are earned, not determined by years of experience alone. They reflect the responsibility you take on and the dedication you bring to each project. If you’re ready to rise to the challenge, we’d love to hear from you. Key responsibilities Conduct risk assessments, hazard reviews, workplace inspections, and safety assessments across company operations. jobs.title: Clinical Solutions Consultant
jobs.description: About Rivia Rivia is a technology company building a data engine that powers the future of clinical trial intelligence. Rivia was founded on the belief that new drugs can be brought to market more successfully with a fraction of today's capital. Biotechs are the source of most therapeutic innovation, yet clinical development is constantly constrained by fragmented data and outdated tooling. Rivia unifies clinical trial data at scale through a core engine built as a reusable intelligence layer, comprising hundreds of configurations and trial-specific logic, independent of source structure. This vertical stack of data engine, workflows, and agents creates a distinct advantage in how trials are operated. Over the past two years, European- and US-based biotechs running global clinical trials on Rivia have demonstrated measurable impact, from earlier understanding of therapeutic potential to significantly more efficient trial execution. In March 2026, Rivia raised its $15M Series A led by Earlybird Venture Capital. Rivia's ambition is to become the standard infrastructure for modern drug development, transforming how trials are executed end-to-end. The Role As our Clinical Solutions Consultant, you'll be the bridge between science, technology, and sales, helping biotech and pharma companies understand how Rivia can transform the way they work with clinical trial data. You'll partner closely with our Account Executives throughout the technical stages of the sales cycle, turning complex scientific and technical challenges into compelling product demonstrations, tailored sandboxes, and solutions that address real customer needs. This isn't a role where you simply present slides or follow a demo script. You'll need to understand clinical trial workflows, get hands-on with data, challenge assumptions, and translate complex customer requirements into solutions we can actually deliver. jobs.title: Clinical Data Manager
jobs.description: General Summary The temporary Clinical Data Manager acts as a lead data manager for one or more projects, applies data management experience to clinical trials, and utilizes functional knowledge of the logistics of clinical trials to ensure the quality and integrity of clinical trial data. The CDM works on multi-functional teams and supports clinical trial projects as a departmental subject matter expert (SME). We are seeking a temporary clinical data manager who can dedicate 20 hours a week to support ongoing study activities. The initial assignment is for 6 months, but may be extended to meet the needs of our Team. Applicants must be eligible to live and work in the US.
